title: Te Kaimau o ngā Tohu e Iwa
intro: I ara ake tētahi tangata i te tīmatanga tino iti, me te mutunga kua tuhia ki roto i te hiahia o te Atua. I huna i te tamarikitanga, ā, i whakatipuria i roto i ngā pakitara o te rangatira tonu i whai ki te whakangaro i ō rātou iwi, i karangatia tēnei wairua ki tētahi misioni nui. Ko te whakapono me te tokotoko hepara iti anake te mea i mau i a rātou, i tū rātou i mua i te rangatira tino kaha o te ao, ā, i tono kia herea te hunga i hereherea. Ko te ao tonu i te āhua nei i neke i raro i tā rātou whakahau - i wehea ngā wai, i kōrero ngā rangi, ā, i hinga te rangatiratanga.
clues: I kitea ōku rā tuatahi i te wehi — i whaia ngā pēpi pēnei i ahau i te whānautanga e tētahi rangatira nanakia i wehi i te heke mai.
I whakaorangia ahau e te wai, i whakatupuria hoki i roto i te whare kingi o te rangatira tonu i whai kia whakangaromia ahau.
I rere atu ahau i tōku whenua tupu i muri i tētahi aituā ohorere, ā, ka riro hei hepara iti i tētahi whenua tawhiti.
I hoki atu ahau ki te tū atu ki taua rangatira mana nui me te tokotoko māmā me te karere mārama, e tono ana kia herekoretia tōku iwi.
I wehea e ahau tētahi wai nui mō te hunga i aru mai i ahau, ā, i mātakitaki ahau i aua wai e horomia katoatia ana tōku hoariri.
I piki ahau i tētahi maunga tapu kia whiwhi ai ahau i ngā aratohu atua mai i a Allah, ā, i homai ki ahau ngā tohu mārama e iwa hei tohu mō te pono.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
